question: In a certain code language, 'MARKS' is written as 'NASLT', and 'PORT' is written as 'QOSU'. How will 'FINGER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea82bd5c97415b6a0bb4a31c9208d4af49dfee9c43ef8ee84e3fd4a2b56e847.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Consonants coded as the next letter and vowels remain the same vowels.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2452a184a10039c88a5547ac8bba861f5d031069354f6370911cd214c5d47488.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04c68a2fb0200a4a3d1997cdf8eb0e11d3707c10712767d90576d90243209c93.png] 

Therefore,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1eca1e9384d7b249564ed28373e4f392f212d1ae23ff994946343f36ad6cea8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "GIOHES".**
